# Regolo.ai

> Regolo.ai is a European LLM inference provider: an OpenAI-compatible API with Zero Data Retention, full EU data residency (Seeweb / DHH Group data centers), powered by 100% renewable energy. It offers serverless access to open-weight models (chat, embeddings, rerank, vision, image generation, speech-to-text) and dedicated GPU deployment of custom Hugging Face models.

Regolo is built for AI teams that need GDPR-compliant, EU-sovereign inference without infrastructure complexity. Integration is drop-in: swap the base URL to https://api.regolo.ai/v1 and keep using the OpenAI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or any OpenAI-compatible tool. Data is processed in volatile memory and never stored, logged, or used for training. A free 30-day trial is available, no credit card required.

## Platform

- [Homepage](https://regolo.ai/): Product overview, use cases (RAG, conversational AI, document processing, content generation, transcription, code assistance), and getting-started examples
- [Models Library](https://regolo.ai/models/): Full catalog of pre-loaded models with pricing and limits, callable via the OpenAI-compatible API
- [Pricing](https://regolo.ai/pricing/): Pay-as-you-go token pricing, subscription plans (Core, Boost, Pro, Scale), free 30-day trial, and hourly GPU instance pricing
- [Custom Models](https://regolo.ai/pricing/): Deploy any vLLM-compatible model from Hugging Face on dedicated EU GPUs with hourly billing and no lock-in
- [Case Studies](https://regolo.ai/case-studies/): Production deployments of Regolo inference in customer products
- [Regolo Labs](https://regolo.ai/labs/): Technical blog — compliance, benchmarks, cost optimization, self-hosting, and tutorials
- [Models Archive](https://regolo.ai/models-archive/): Models previously published on the platform

## Documentation & Tools

- [Documentation](https://docs.regolo.ai/): Quickstarts for Python, Node.js, and cURL; guides for chat completions, vision, image generation, speech-to-text, embeddings, rerank, and reasoning
- [API Reference](https://docs.regolo.ai/): Complete OpenAI-compatible API docs with Swagger UI; base URL https://api.regolo.ai/v1
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.regolo.ai/): Sign up, generate API keys, deploy custom models, monitor token usage
- [Model Catalog](https://docs.regolo.ai/): Browse all available models from the docs

## Core Models (pay-as-you-go, EUR per 1M tokens input/output)

- apertus-70b: €0.40 / €2.10 — open multilingual LLM
- brick-complexity-pro: €0.10 / €0.40 — Regolo's spatial routing/complexity model for cost optimization
- brick-v1-beta: €0.00 / €0.00 — free beta routing model
- gemma4-31b: €0.40 / €2.10
- glm5.2: €2.00 / €5.20 — 744B MoE (40B active), 1M context, MIT license, long-horizon coding
- gpt-oss-120b: €1.00 / €4.20 — OpenAI open-weight flagship, reasoning support
- gpt-oss-20b: €0.10 / €0.42 — lightweight open-weight model
- Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct: €0.60 / €2.70 — balanced general-purpose chat
- mistral-small-4-119b: €0.50 / €2.10 — 256K context, reasoning_effort support
- qwen3-coder-next: €0.50 / €2.00 — code-specialized, 262K context
- qwen3.5-122b: €1.00 / €4.20 — maximum reasoning quality
- qwen3.5-9b: €0.07 / €0.35 — low-cost dev/test
- qwen3.6-27b: €0.50 / €2.10

The catalog also includes embedding models (e.g., qwen3-embedding-8b), rerankers (qwen3-reranker-4b), image generation (qwen-image), and speech-to-text. All chat models are included in subscriptions.

## GPU Instances for Custom Models (hourly)

- NVIDIA RTX6000 (24 GB): €0.29/h
- NVIDIA L4 (24 GB): €0.38/h — also 2x and 4x configurations
- NVIDIA RTXA6000 (47.3 GB): €0.74/h — also 2x and 4x
- NVIDIA L40S (48 GB): €0.85/h — also 2x and 4x
- NVIDIA A100 (80 GB): €0.99/h — also 2x
- NVIDIA RTXPRO6000 (96 GB): €1.25/h — also 2x and 4x
- NVIDIA H100 (80 GB): €1.89/h
- NVIDIA H200 (141 GB): €2.60/h — also 2x and 4x

## Regolo Labs — Compliance & Privacy

- [What Is EU AI Act Compliance for AI Infrastructure? A CTO's Guide](https://regolo.ai/what-is-eu-ai-act-compliance-for-ai-infrastructure-a-ctos-guide/): Obligations for infrastructure providers after the 2 August 2026 deadline
- [The EU AI Act beyond the basics](https://regolo.ai/the-eu-ai-act-beyond-the-basics-the-obligations-most-guides-forget/): The obligations most guides forget — Article 30 records, DPAs, DPIAs, audit trails
- [Article 50 AI Act compliance for generative AI](https://regolo.ai/article-50-ai-act-compliance-for-generative-ai-a-practical-guide-for-ctos-and-agency-developers/): Transparency obligations, marking, deepfake labelling, 30-point checklist
- [AI Act, August 2, 2026: what CTOs must actually do](https://regolo.ai/ai-act-august-2-2026-what-ctos-must-actually-do/): Inventory, risk classification, ownership, logging, documentation
- [AI privacy and compliance in 2026](https://regolo.ai/ai-privacy-and-compliance-in-2026-what-changes-for-llm-providers/): What changes for LLM providers under the AI Act and GDPR
- [Data Privacy First: CTO Guide to AI Act Compliance](https://regolo.ai/data-privacy-first-ai-act-cto-guide/): Zero-retention architecture and GDPR-ready scaling
- [Multi-agent AI for compliance in banks and insurers](https://regolo.ai/multi-agent-ai-for-compliance-in-banks-and-insurers-a-practical-playbook/): Practical playbook for regulated multi-agent workflows (KYC, AML)
- [AI governance, copyright, and enterprise risk](https://regolo.ai/ai-governance-copyright-and-enterprise-risk-how-to-build-a-policy-gateway-before-you-ship/): Building a policy gateway before shipping
- [Human-in-the-loop for autonomous AI agents](https://regolo.ai/human-in-the-loop-autonomous-ai-agents-governance/): Fail-safes, escalation protocols, and governance tiers

- [DeepAgents + Brick: A Production Agent Harness at a Fraction of the Inference Cost](https://regolo.ai/deepagents-brick-a-production-agent-harness-at-a-fraction-of-the-inference-cost/): LangChain's DeepAgents harness with Brick as the inference routing layer

## Company

- [DHH Group](https://regolo.ai/dhh-group/): Regolo.ai is developed by Seeweb within the DHH Group, European cloud and digital infrastructure group
- [GPU Cloud Infrastructure](https://regolo.ai/team-infrastructure/): Serverless GPU cloud powered by Seeweb and VAST Data (H100/H200)
- [European Presence](https://regolo.ai/european-presence/): EU data residency; no retention, logging, or reuse of input/output data
- [Why open source and green infrastructure](https://regolo.ai/why-open-source-and-green-infrastructure-are-at-the-core-of-regolo-ais-european-llm-platform/): The platform's founding principles
